changes: Added the capability_release_backfill CLI (record-then-bind migration): for a past DONE story with an artifact release but no capability release, dry-run detects the under-bound candidate, and --apply (behind a --digest confirm gate) records the missing capability release by classifying the artifact-release paths, then binds the candidate lineage. Ran it live on B-785e — the real PBP-882 candidate is now bound to PCR-9e7fdacf081e7346181bc04d and stays inert. M6/M7 needed no new code: two capability-aware smokes prove capability candidates flow through the existing playbook_promotion_status/playbook_trial_run/playbook_outcome_record/playbook_promotion_sweep machinery.
expectedOutcome: dry-run lists under-bound candidates + a plan digest; --apply (with matching --digest) records the missing capability release and binds the candidate lineage; re-run shows 0 eligible (idempotent); the bound candidate stays status=candidate.
actualTranscript: capability_release_backfill --storyId=B-785e --dryRun: eligibleCount=1 plan=[PBP-882] planDigest=sha256:fc69f277...; --apply --digest=...: recorded PCR-9e7fdacf081e7346181bc04d + bound PBP-882; re-run dryRun: eligibleCount=0; capability_release_status B-785e: count=1; PBP-882 lineage now carries capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId=docs-requirements/version/artifactReleaseId, status=candidate, surfacedCount=0.
outcomeDiff: No difference — the shipped command produced exactly the expected dry-run/apply/idempotent transcript and the live PBP-882 is bound and inert.
limitations: Only the targeted B-785e live backfill was applied (binding PBP-882, the motivating case); the full 11-story migration is available via the same command but deliberately not run. The M6 exposure surfaces and M7 outcome/promotion machinery were pre-existing generic commands — this story wires+verifies capability candidates through them, it does not add new M6/M7 command surfaces.
pitfalls: record-then-bind needs the story artifact-release paths as the classifier input (persisted in the artifact record). The verificationIntent freeze forced a DEV->PLAN->DEV round-trip to correct CHK-001 adversarial wording (backfill DOES append non_authoritative PCRs, does not never-mutate-the-ledger). High-risk assurance floor (command-policy.ts writer entry) required genuine Codex cross-host review (v3+v6 pass; one earlier codex fail was an adversarially-disproven false positive re authority/gateEvidence) + quorum_submit. Raise LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS for the 41-command validate.
